new_rows.claim: The optimal-move subgraph at 3x3 CONTAINS-CYCLES (exhaustive: 47,456 states / 76,244 edges, T416) — 54 cyclic SCCs, 12 FORCED cycles / 80 states, value constant on all 54 cycles; MEASUREMENT kept (single-instrument self-report + one byte-identical console re-run is not a second-seat adjudication). Absorbed 2026-08-08 (T418); /tmp evidence citations re-pointed to docs/evidence/T416-OPTIMAL-CYCLE/.

The optimal-move subgraph at 4x4 CONTAINS-CYCLES on a declared SAMPLE (150,001 / 99,133,036 = 0.15%; 6 cyclic SCCs; 0 FORCED in the sample is a LOWER BOUND, not '0 forced at 4x4'; exhaustive killed twice by the 4 GB RSS guard) — scope limits carried verbatim; MEASUREMENT kept. Absorbed 2026-08-08 (T418).

Bracket resolvers are pluggable via src/resolver.zig (Resolver/ResolveContext/Resolution, ADR-0022); none is authoritative. Renamed from RESOLVER.INTERFACE at absorption (RESOLVER. is not an ID scope; CODE. is). PROVEN as a definitional statement about the code and the decision record (11 unit tests pass, 1 deliberate skip, re-verified at absorption).

The capture budget is demoted to a named pluggable resolver (capture_budget(B)) whose registration metadata records its measured non-convergence (4x3 root oscillates {0,1,2,7,9,12}, never PSK +4); internal consistency is not external agreement (ADR-0022). Renamed from RESOLVER.BUDGET-QUARANTINE and DOWNGRADED from the PROVEN proposal to CLAIMED at absorption: the load-bearing oscillation datum is single-instrument T387, same class as GLOBAL.CAPTURE-BUDGET-DAG (MEASUREMENT, T404); no second seat has adjudicated it.

The resolver comparison harness has null (none proposes nothing) and seeded (deliberately_wrong REFUTED) controls; both fire correctly at 3x3 over 23,420 positions. Renamed from RESOLVER.CONTROLS at absorption; PROVEN per brief rule 3 (exhaustive within the harness; independently re-run at absorption: null 0/23,420, seeded REFUTED 20,216/20,216, capture_budget proposes 20,216/23,420 / abstains 3,204/23,420).

directives.row_text: | `3x3.OPTIMAL-CYCLE` | — | 3x3 | **The optimal-move subgraph at 3×3 (all optimal children kept, ties included) CONTAINS-CYCLES — exhaustive over 47,456 states / 76,244 edges (T416, 2026-08-08, instrument `src/t416_cycle.zig`; artifact `data/oracle-3x3-v2.wzo2`; re-run byte-identical by an independent console).** 54 cyclic SCCs, 4,550 states on cycles (9.6% of states); value constant on all 54 cycles (0 bad). The forced/indifferent split: **12 FORCED cycles / 80 states** (every node strictly prefers to stay — the loop is compelled under optimal play by both sides) and **42 INDIFFERENT cycles / 4,470 states** (an optimal exit exists at ≥1 node — the loop is available, not compelled). Tautology guard `V_p==Bellman-best`: 0 / 47,456 mismatches.
